description: Answers 'what did these stocks do between these dates?' Give symbols (a list, or '/ES' for a futures root - plain 'ES' is the stock Eversource), start and end dates. Returns daily OHLCV bars clipped to as_of so no future data leaks; up to 5,000 rows per page, use next_cursor for more. Covers 16,000+ US stocks since 2000 including delisted names, plus 5,100+ ETFs. Free keys get daily bars for the last 12 months; intraday bars and full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_bars
title: Get OHLCV bars
